typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Use IBM Plex Sans for a technical, serious ERP feel. Keep letter spacing tight for headings. Never use Inter.

colors.archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST (Modified for Financial ERP)
colors.instructions_to_main_agent: Implement this color palette via Tailwind configuration. Avoid pure black or pure white except for card surfaces and absolute backgrounds. Use status colors for NF-e states (Authorized = success, Draft = warning, Cancelled = error).

layouts.app_shell: Sidebar navigation (dark mode styled #0F172A) on the left (w-64). Main content area on the right with a top header (h-16, sticky, white with bottom border).
layouts.dashboard_grid: High-density Grid Mode B (Data Correlation). Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6. Summary cards col-span-1, primary charts col-span-2 or 3.
layouts.nfe_emission_form: Multi-step wizard layout. Use a horizontal progress bar or stepper at the top. Form sections should be contained within crisp cards with p-6 or p-8.
layouts.data_tables: Full-width cards containing Shadcn tables. Include top bar for search/filters and bottom bar for pagination. Use flat rectangular style for rows.
layouts.instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure grid items are direct children. Use generous padding (p-6, p-8) inside cards. Do not center-align the whole app; keep it left-aligned and structured.

components.cards: Flat, sharp edges or subtle roundness (rounded-md max). 1px solid border (border-slate-200), no heavy shadows. On hover, slight lift and shadow-sm.
components.buttons: Rectangular with subtle rounding (rounded-md). Primary buttons use brand blue. Danger actions use red.
components.inputs: Shadcn input components. Focus states must have a 2px ring of primary blue (ring-blue-500) to ensure accessibility.
components.badges: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for statuses. Subtle backgrounds (e.g., bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700) for better readability.
components.instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn/UI for tables, forms, select, dialogs, dropdowns. Do NOT use native HTML inputs or selects. Use Recharts for dashboard charts.

motion.hover: Subtle background color shifts on table rows and sidebar links.
motion.transitions: Use specific transitions (e.g., transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform). Do NOT use 'transition-all'.
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-in for dashboard cards and table rows.
motion.instructions_to_main_agent: Keep animations minimal. This is a professional tool. Focus on micro-interactions for feedback.

auth_background.description: Modern glass-panel office hallway to be used as a split-screen background on the login/register page.

media.instructions_to_main_agent: Install @phosphor-icons/react. Use Phosphor icons for all UI elements (sidebar, buttons, table actions). Never use AI assistant emoji characters.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets 4.5:1 minimum contrast. Use text-slate-600 or darker for body.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, menu items, table rows) MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
accessibility.instructions_to_main_agent: Strict adherence to data-testid assignment. Never rely solely on color to indicate status; always pair with text or an icon.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap. Padding inside cards should be p-6 or p-8.
Never use pure black or gray gradients. Use flat solid colors for an ERP.
Do not use HTML-based components for advanced user interactions; rely on Shadcn.
Create depth through 1px borders and layered design, not heavy shadows.
When customizing Shadcn components, be mindful of opinionated rules like fixed heights.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds in headers or dropdowns that overlay content.
